title: Banh mi bowl with lemongrass pork
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into fine strips and marinate them with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar for 10 minutes.
Finely chop the lemongrass and garlic, mix with the fish sauce and remaining sugar and marinate the sliced pork in it.
Fry the pork in the oil for 2–3 minutes per side.
Arrange the rice, pork and pickled vegetables in bowls and sprinkle with coriander and chilli.
